description: This file is a build script written in JavaScript using Node.js. It creates a directory, defines a script wrapper, and writes it to a file with execute permissions. The script primarily manages file system operations and process spawning to run another script.

methods.name: fs.mkdirSync
methods.description: Creates a directory and any necessary parent directories asynchronously.

methods.name: fs.writeFileSync
methods.description: Writes data to a file synchronously, creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: path.resolve
methods.description: Resolves a sequence of paths or path segments into an absolute path.

methods.name: path.dirname
methods.description: Returns the directory name of a path.

methods.name: path.join
methods.description: Joins all given path segments together using the platform-specific separator.

methods.name: fileURLToPath
methods.description: Converts a file URL to a system path.
